essential_elements.diagnosis: Multiple barrier theorems constrain broad proof templates and force barrier-aware method design.

essential_elements.name: Bridge-Hypothesis Dependence
essential_elements.diagnosis: Progress currently depends on conjectural bridges/hypotheses to connect otherwise weakly linked conceptual regions.

essential_elements.name: Plural, Underdetermined Strategy Space
essential_elements.diagnosis: Top entry points span multiple conceptual phases, indicating no single dominant route and high epistemic underdetermination.

essential_elements.name: Sparse Explicit Dependency Structure
essential_elements.diagnosis: Most canonical statements are not yet wired by formal depends_on links, so proof navigation is underdetermined.

essential_elements.name: Asymmetric Lower-Bound Evidence
essential_elements.diagnosis: The KB has strong restricted-model lower bounds but relatively fewer direct bridges to full separation targets.
